articles.headline: VAR controversy ignites Elland Road as Leeds bring Tottenham back down to earth
articles.description: Tottenham's unbeaten run was ended at Leeds but do Roberto De Zerbi's side have a right to be aggrieved with the officials? ESPN's Tom Chambers reports from Elland Road.

articles.description: Hislop backs decision to not send off Leeds' Bogle vs. Spurs

articles.headline: De Zerbi questions Leeds-Spurs refereeing, Farke says Jayden Bogle 'my butterfly'
articles.description: Tottenham head coach Roberto De Zerbi was critical of the officials after Jayden Bogle was not sent off for his collision with Mathys Tel on Saturday, but Daniel Farke defended the Leeds defender who he described as "my butterfly."

articles.headline: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham as-it-happened: Okafor grabs late winner for Farke's side
articles.description: Noah Okafor scored the only goal of the game as Tottenham Hotspur's winning run was ended by Leeds.

articles.headline: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham: Noah Okafor strike ends Spurs, De Zerbi's winning run
articles.description: A Noah Okafor goal gave Leeds all three points from their clash with Tottenham as the visitors' three-match winning streak was brought to an abrupt end.

articles.headline: Tottenham's winning run brought to abrupt end by late Noah Okafor winner
articles.description: Noah Okafor stepped off the bench to snatch Leeds three points as they beat Tottenham 1-0 at Elland Road to snap their five-game winless Premier League run.

articles.headline: Roberto De Zerbi: Tottenham rising star Luca Williams-Barnett ready to start matches
articles.description: Roberto De Zerbi believes Tottenham's highly-rated youngster Luca Williams-Barnett is ready to start matches.

articles.headline: Run, Man United, run: How preseason fitness can hinder Premier League form
articles.description: Man United rank poorly compared to other Premier League teams in every running statistic presented, and there is no way to rectify it this season.

articles.headline: Crystal Palace appeal over Jean-Philippe Mateta red card rejected
articles.description: Crystal Palace striker Jean-Philippe Mateta will serve a three-match ban after an appeal against his red card in Saturday's 2-0 Premier League defeat at Tottenham was rejected.

articles.headline: Tottenham's Dejan Kulusevski named in Sweden squad for the first time in two years
articles.description: Dejan Kulusevski has been called up to the Sweden squad as he continues his return from a 17-month absence with a patella injury in his right knee.

articles.headline: Cole Palmer should have been sent off for Mateus Fernandes clash - KMI panel
articles.description: Cole Palmer should have been sent off for Chelsea against Tottenham 10 minutes before he actually was, according to a panel which assesses the decisions of Premier League referees and VARs.

articles.headline: Steven Gerrard names Premier League wonderkid to watch: 'I have seen enough'
articles.description: Tottenham academy prospect Luca Williams-Barnett has shown in just a few moments why he is definitely a young player "to look out for," according to former England captain Steven Gerrard.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Both Manchester clubs eye move for USMNT's Freeman
articles.description: Several Premier League clubs are interested in signing Villarreal and United States international Alex Freeman. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Archie Gray: Marbella trip 'helped' Tottenham camaraderie
articles.description: Archie Gray was gutted to come off during Tottenham's win over Crystal Palace but happy to put the team first and help his "brothers" secure another three points.

articles.headline: Robert De Zerbi on Tottenham revival: 'Now we are playing as a team'
articles.description: Roberto De Zerbi believes Tottenham's turnaround in the Premier League is down to his new-look squad now being a team.

articles.headline: Under-fire Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage: 'I will never give up'
articles.description: Under-pressure Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage vowed to never give up and be the first on the training pitch on Monday despite Saturday's 2-0 loss at Tottenham.

articles.headline: Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace: Spurs cruise to comfortable home win - as it happened
articles.description: Goals from Archie Gray and Jean-Paul van Hecke saw Tottenham Hotspur cruise past a poor 10-man Crystal Palace side 2-0 to move up to eighth in the Premier League.

articles.headline: Tottenham's resurgence continues with win over 10-man Crystal Palace
articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur made it three Premier League wins in a row for the first time in 20 months with a comfortable 2-0 victory over 10-man Crystal Palace.
